verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Airweave searching across many sources in a single query and syncing whole data sources automatically. Neither is a documented user-invoked bulk operation, such as batch-creating, updating, deleting or re-syncing many collections or source connections in one call. Cross-source search and automatic sync are adjacent behaviors and do not count as bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
